name: Spinach & Feta Egg White Omelet
steps: Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and wilt the spinach for 1 minute.
Pour in the egg whites, season with pepper, and cook undisturbed until the edges set.
Sprinkle feta and green onion over one half, fold the omelet over and cook 1 more minute.
Slide onto a plate and serve immediately.

name: Veggie-Loaded Scrambled Eggs
steps: Sauté onion, bell pepper and mushrooms in olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add spinach and stir until wilted.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, pour over the vegetables and stir gently until softly set.
Fold in the cheddar, remove from heat and serve.

name: Avocado & Egg Sprouted-Grain Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and salt and spread over the toast.
Fry or poach the egg to your liking and set it on top.
Finish with red pepper flakes.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Parfait with Walnuts
steps: Spoon half the yogurt into a glass or bowl.
Layer half the berries and walnuts, then repeat with the remaining yogurt and toppings.
Sprinkle chia seeds and cinnamon on top and serve, or refrigerate up to 24 hours.

name: Overnight Steel-Cut Oats with Blueberries
steps: Combine oats, almond milk, chia seeds, cinnamon and vanilla in a jar and stir well.
Refrigerate overnight (at least 8 hours) so the oats soften without cooking, which keeps the GI lower.
In the morning stir, divide into two bowls and top with blueberries and sliced almonds.

name: Chia Seed Pudding with Raspberries
steps: Whisk chia seeds, almond milk, vanilla and sweetener in a bowl.
Let stand 10 minutes, whisk again to break up clumps, then refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Spoon into bowls and top with raspberries and sliced almonds.

name: Cottage Cheese Bowl with Peaches & Pecans
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Slice the peach and arrange on top.
Sprinkle with chopped pecans, ground flaxseed and cinnamon.

name: Southwest Breakfast Burrito
steps: Sauté onion and bell pepper in olive oil for 4 minutes, add black beans and cumin and warm through.
Whisk the eggs, pour into the pan and scramble until just set.
Warm the tortillas, fill with the egg mixture, cheese, avocado and salsa.
Roll tightly, folding in the sides, and cut in half.

name: Turkey Sausage & Kale Frittata
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Brown crumbled turkey sausage in an ovenproof skillet, then remove.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil, add kale and cook until wilted. Return sausage to the pan.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, pour over the filling and scatter mozzarella on top.
Cook 2 minutes on the stove, then bake 15–18 minutes until set. Cool 5 minutes before slicing.

name: Almond Flour Blueberry Pancakes
steps: Whisk eggs, almond milk, vanilla and sweetener, then stir in almond flour and baking powder to a thick batter.
Fold in the blueberries.
Cook 1/4-cup portions in coconut oil over medium-low heat, 3 minutes per side, flipping carefully.
Serve warm with extra berries if desired.

name: Shakshuka with Feta
steps: Sauté onion and bell pepper in olive oil over medium heat for 7 minutes, add garlic, cumin and paprika and cook 1 minute.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, season with salt and simmer 10 minutes until slightly thickened.
Make four wells, crack an egg into each, cover and cook 6–8 minutes until whites are set.
Top with crumbled feta and parsley and serve straight from the pan.

name: Smoked Salmon & Cream Cheese Egg Wrap
steps: Whisk eggs and cook in a lightly oiled nonstick pan as one thin round crepe-like layer, about 2 minutes.
Slide the egg wrap onto a plate and spread with cream cheese.
Layer smoked salmon, thin cucumber slices, capers and dill.
Roll up tightly and slice in half.

name: Peanut Butter Protein Smoothie
steps: Add almond milk, protein powder, peanut butter, spinach, banana and chia seeds to a blender.
Add a handful of ice and blend on high until completely smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink right away.

name: Green Power Smoothie
steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend on high for 45–60 seconds until silky.
Adjust thickness with water and serve cold.

name: Mushroom & Swiss Omelet
steps: Sauté mushrooms in half the butter until browned, about 5 minutes; set aside.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, melt the remaining butter and pour in the eggs, tilting the pan as they set.
Add mushrooms and Swiss cheese to one side, fold and cook 1 minute more.
Garnish with chives.

name: Tomato, Basil & Mozzarella Egg Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and oil a 9-inch baking dish.
Whisk eggs, milk, garlic, salt and pepper; pour into the dish.
Scatter halved cherry tomatoes and torn mozzarella over the top.
Bake 25–30 minutes until puffed and set; top with torn basil before serving.

name: Egg Muffin Cups with Broccoli & Cheddar
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and oil a 12-cup muffin tin.
Steam finely chopped broccoli 2 minutes and divide among the cups with cheddar and green onion.
Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper and pour over the fillings.
Bake 20–22 minutes until set. Cool, then refrigerate up to 5 days or freeze.

name: Savory Oatmeal with Egg & Avocado
steps: Simmer oats in broth for 8–10 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Meanwhile fry the egg in olive oil until the white is set and yolk still runny.
Spoon oats into a bowl, top with the egg, sliced avocado, green onion and parmesan.
Add a dash of hot sauce.

name: Cinnamon Ricotta Bowl with Strawberries
steps: Whisk ricotta with vanilla, cinnamon and sweetener until fluffy.
Spoon into a bowl and top with sliced strawberries.
Sprinkle with chopped pistachios.

name: Huevos Rancheros with Black Beans
steps: Warm black beans with cumin and mash lightly.
Toast tortillas in a dry skillet until pliable and lightly charred.
Fry the eggs in olive oil until the whites are set.
Top each tortilla with beans, two eggs, warm salsa, avocado, cotija and cilantro.

name: Turkey Bacon, Egg & Cheese English Muffin
steps: Cook turkey bacon in a skillet until crisp; set aside.
Fry the egg in olive oil, breaking the yolk for a firmer sandwich.
Toast the English muffin and layer cheese, egg, bacon and tomato slices.
Close and serve warm.

name: Zucchini & Goat Cheese Frittata
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Sauté onion and grated zucchini in olive oil in an ovenproof skillet until moisture evaporates, 6 minutes.
Whisk eggs with thyme, salt and pepper and pour over the vegetables.
Dot with goat cheese and bake 15 minutes until just set.
Rest 5 minutes and cut into wedges.

name: Tofu Veggie Scramble
steps: Press the tofu and crumble it with your hands.
Sauté onion and bell pepper in olive oil for 4 minutes, add tofu, turmeric, garlic powder, salt and pepper and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in spinach and nutritional yeast and cook until wilted.
Serve hot with hot sauce if desired.

name: Salmon & Asparagus Egg Skillet
steps: Sauté chopped asparagus in olive oil for 4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add flaked salmon and green onion and warm through.
Pour in whisked eggs seasoned with salt and stir gently until softly scrambled.
Finish with dill and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Peanut Butter Chia Overnight Oats
steps: Stir oats, chia, almond milk, yogurt, peanut butter and cinnamon together in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with sliced strawberries before eating.

name: Breakfast Tacos with Eggs & Pico
steps: Whisk the eggs and scramble softly in olive oil.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill each with eggs, cheddar, pico de gallo, avocado and sliced jalapeño.
Top with cilantro and serve.

name: Cauliflower Hash Browns with Fried Eggs
steps: Microwave cauliflower rice 4 minutes, cool and squeeze dry in a clean towel.
Mix with 2 beaten eggs, parmesan, green onion, garlic powder and salt; form 4 patties.
Pan-fry in olive oil 4–5 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Fry the remaining 2 eggs and serve on top of the hash browns.

name: Denver Omelet
steps: Sauté diced ham, bell pepper and onion in olive oil for 4 minutes.
Pour in whisked, seasoned eggs and cook until nearly set.
Sprinkle cheddar over one half, fold and cook 1 minute more.
Slide onto a plate.

name: Apple Cinnamon Baked Oatmeal Cups
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a muffin tin.
Whisk eggs, almond milk, yogurt, vanilla and sweetener; stir in oats, cinnamon, baking powder, diced apple and walnuts.
Divide into 12 cups and bake 22–25 minutes until set.
Cool completely; keep refrigerated 5 days or freeze.

name: Lox Bagel Bowl (No Bagel)
steps: Spread cottage cheese in a shallow bowl.
Arrange smoked salmon, sliced cucumber, tomato and red onion on top.
Scatter capers, dill and everything seasoning and serve.

name: Egg & Veggie Breakfast Quesadilla
steps: Sauté mushrooms and spinach in half the oil, add whisked eggs and scramble.
Place the tortilla in the pan, put cheese and eggs on one half and fold.
Cook 2 minutes per side in the remaining oil until crisp.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Pumpkin Spice Protein Oats
steps: Simmer oats, pumpkin puree and almond milk for 6–7 minutes, stirring.
Remove from heat and stir in protein powder, spice and sweetener.
Top with chopped pecans.

name: Caprese Egg Cups
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and oil 8 muffin cups.
Divide halved tomatoes, mozzarella and basil among the cups.
Pour in whisked eggs with milk and salt and bake 18–20 minutes.
Cool 5 minutes before removing.

name: Steak & Eggs with Sautéed Spinach
steps: Season the steak and sear in olive oil 3–4 minutes per side for medium; rest 5 minutes.
In the same pan, sauté garlic and spinach until wilted.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Slice the steak and serve with eggs and spinach.

name: Berry Kefir Smoothie
steps: Blend kefir, berries, flaxseed, protein powder and vanilla until smooth.
Add ice if you like it thicker.
Serve immediately.

name: Mediterranean Breakfast Plate
steps: Hard-boil the eggs (8 minutes), cool and halve.
Arrange eggs, cucumber, tomato, olives and feta on a plate.
Add hummus drizzled with olive oil and za'atar, and the warmed pita half on the side.

name: Cottage Cheese Egg Bites (Sous-Vide Style)
steps: Preheat oven to 325°F and set a silicone muffin pan in a larger pan of hot water.
Blend eggs, cottage cheese, salt and pepper until smooth.
Divide chopped pepper, spinach and cheese among 8 cups and pour in the egg mixture.
Bake in the water bath 28–30 minutes until just set.

name: Sweet Potato & Turkey Breakfast Hash
steps: Cook diced sweet potato in olive oil over medium heat, covered, for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add onion, pepper and turkey; cook until browned, seasoning with paprika and salt.
Stir in kale until wilted. Make three wells and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook 5 minutes until the eggs are set.

name: Egg Salad Lettuce Wraps
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, cool, peel and chop.
Mix with yogurt, mayo, Dijon, celery, chives, salt and pepper.
Spoon into butter lettuce leaves and serve.

name: Coconut Almond Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk chia with both milks, vanilla and stevia; refrigerate overnight.
Toast coconut and almonds in a dry pan for 2 minutes.
Top the pudding with blackberries and the toasted mix.

name: Spinach Mushroom Crustless Quiche
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and oil a 9-inch pie dish.
Sauté onion and mushrooms in olive oil until dry and golden, add spinach and wilt.
Whisk eggs, milk, yogurt, nutmeg and salt; stir in the vegetables and cheese and pour into the dish.
Bake 35–40 minutes until the center is set. Rest 10 minutes.

name: Protein Waffles (Oat & Cottage Cheese)
steps: Blend oats, cottage cheese, eggs, baking powder, vanilla and cinnamon into a smooth batter.
Cook in a preheated, lightly greased waffle iron until golden, about 4 minutes per waffle.
Serve with Greek yogurt and sliced strawberries.

name: Breakfast Salad with Poached Egg
steps: Poach the eggs in simmering water with a splash of vinegar for 3 minutes.
Toss greens with olive oil, lemon juice and salt.
Top with avocado, tomatoes, pumpkin seeds and the poached eggs.

name: Chorizo-Style Turkey Breakfast Skillet
steps: Mix turkey with chili powder, paprika, cumin, vinegar and salt to make a quick chorizo.
Brown the turkey mixture with onion and pepper in olive oil, breaking it up, about 10 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until set.
Sprinkle with cilantro.

name: Blueberry Cottage Cheese Pancakes
steps: Blend cottage cheese, eggs, oats, vanilla and baking powder until smooth.
Fold in blueberries and let batter rest 5 minutes.
Cook small pancakes in coconut oil over medium-low heat, 2–3 minutes per side.

name: Eggs Benedict on Portobello with Yogurt Hollandaise
steps: Brush portobellos with olive oil and roast at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Whisk yogurt, lemon juice, Dijon and melted butter for a quick hollandaise; warm gently.
Poach the eggs 3 minutes and sear the Canadian bacon.
Stack mushroom, bacon and egg, spoon sauce over and top with chives.

name: Almond Butter Banana Protein Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with almond butter and top with thin banana slices.
Sprinkle with hemp seeds and cinnamon.

name: Ham & Asparagus Egg White Frittata
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Sauté onion and asparagus pieces in oil in an ovenproof skillet for 4 minutes; add diced ham.
Whisk egg whites and eggs with pepper, pour over and sprinkle with parmesan.
Bake 15 minutes until set; slice into wedges.

name: Chocolate Avocado Protein Smoothie
steps: Combine everything in a blender.
Blend until creamy and thick.
Serve immediately.

name: Bacon, Egg & Avocado Breakfast Bowl
steps: Cook bacon until crisp; drain and crumble.
Fry the eggs in a little of the bacon fat or olive oil.
Fill a bowl with arugula, tomatoes and sliced avocado; add eggs and bacon and season.

name: Buckwheat Porridge with Cherries & Almonds
steps: Warm cooked buckwheat with almond milk, cinnamon and vanilla until creamy, 5 minutes.
Divide into bowls.
Top with pitted cherries and sliced almonds.

name: Egg-in-a-Hole Avocado
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Halve the avocado and scoop out a little flesh to enlarge the cavities.
Set halves in a small dish, crack an egg into each and season.
Bake 12–15 minutes until whites are set; top with cheddar for the last 2 minutes.
Garnish with chives and hot sauce.

name: Veggie Breakfast Bowl with Quinoa
steps: Sauté kale in olive oil until tender; season and add lemon juice.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Divide quinoa between bowls, add kale, tomatoes, avocado and feta, and top with eggs.

name: Smoked Trout & Egg Breakfast Board
steps: Poach or bake trout fillet (or use smoked trout), then flake.
Hard-boil eggs, cool and halve.
Arrange trout, eggs, rye bread, cucumber and radish slices on a board with a bowl of yogurt mixed with dill, lemon and pepper.

name: Cinnamon Apple Cottage Cheese Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with cottage cheese and top with thin apple slices.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and chopped walnuts.

name: Kale & White Bean Breakfast Skillet
steps: Sauté garlic and red pepper flakes in olive oil 30 seconds, add kale and cook until wilted.
Stir in beans, lemon juice and salt; heat through.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5–6 minutes.
Top with parmesan.

name: Turkey & Avocado Breakfast Sandwich
steps: Toast the bread and fry the egg in olive oil.
Spread Dijon on one slice, mash avocado on the other.
Layer turkey, tomato and the egg; close the sandwich.

name: Matcha Chia Protein Pudding
steps: Whisk almond milk with protein powder, matcha, vanilla and sweetener until no lumps remain.
Stir in chia seeds, rest 10 minutes, stir again and refrigerate 4+ hours.
Top with diced kiwi.

name: Mexican Egg White Scramble with Salsa Verde
steps: Warm black beans with cumin in olive oil.
Add egg whites and stir gently until set.
Top with salsa verde, cotija and cilantro.

name: Sardine & Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the rye bread.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and spread on the toast.
Top with sardines, thin red onion, parsley and pepper flakes.

name: Greek Yogurt Protein Bowl with Pomegranate
steps: Stir stevia into the yogurt if desired.
Top with pomegranate arils, pistachios and hemp seeds.
Garnish with torn mint.

name: Egg & Turkey Sausage Breakfast Skillet Pizza
steps: Brown the sausage with pepper and mushrooms in an ovenproof skillet.
Pour in whisked eggs with Italian seasoning; cook until the bottom sets.
Spread marinara over the top, add mozzarella and broil 3–4 minutes until bubbly.
Slice like a pizza.

name: Farro Breakfast Bowl with Pear & Walnuts
steps: Warm cooked farro with almond milk, cinnamon and vanilla for 5 minutes.
Divide into bowls and add a spoon of Greek yogurt.
Top with diced pear and walnuts.

name: Cheesy Cauliflower Breakfast Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Steam cauliflower florets 5 minutes and spread in an oiled 9x13 dish.
Cook turkey bacon until crisp and crumble over the cauliflower.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt and pepper; pour over, top with cheddar and green onion.
Bake 30–35 minutes until golden and set.

name: Strawberry Almond Overnight Oats
steps: Stir oats, almond milk, yogurt, chia and vanilla in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with sliced strawberries and a drizzle of almond butter.

name: Crab & Avocado Omelet
steps: Whisk eggs with Old Bay and cook in olive oil until nearly set.
Add crab and green onion to one half, fold and cook 1 minute.
Top with sliced avocado and lemon juice.

name: Cinnamon Flax Microwave Muffin
steps: Mix flaxseed, egg, baking powder, cinnamon, sweetener and melted coconut oil in a mug.
Microwave 90 seconds until set.
Turn out, split and serve with Greek yogurt and raspberries.

name: Breakfast Stuffed Bell Peppers
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Halve peppers lengthwise and remove seeds; bake 10 minutes.
Brown sausage and wilt spinach together.
Fill the pepper halves with sausage-spinach mix, pour in whisked eggs, top with cheddar.
Bake 18–20 minutes until eggs are set.

name: Tempeh Bacon, Lettuce & Tomato Wrap
steps: Slice tempeh thin and marinate 5 minutes in tamari, paprika and maple syrup.
Pan-fry in olive oil 3 minutes per side until crisp.
Fill tortillas with lettuce, tomato, avocado and tempeh bacon; roll up.

name: Salmon Cakes with Poached Eggs
steps: Mix salmon, 1 egg, almond flour, green onion, Dijon and lemon juice; form 4 patties.
Pan-fry in olive oil 4 minutes per side until golden.
Poach the remaining 2 eggs.
Serve cakes on arugula topped with a poached egg.

name: Pesto Egg Toast
steps: Heat pesto in a nonstick pan and crack in the eggs; fry until whites set.
Toast the bread.
Slide the pesto eggs onto the toast and top with halved tomatoes and parmesan.

name: Blackberry Ricotta Protein Crepes
steps: Blend eggs, egg whites, almond milk, oat flour and vanilla into a thin batter.
Cook thin crepes in a lightly oiled pan, 1 minute per side; makes about 6.
Mix ricotta with sweetener, fill crepes, fold and top with blackberries.

name: Miso Egg Drop Breakfast Soup
steps: Bring broth with ginger to a simmer; add cubed tofu and spinach.
Whisk miso with a ladle of hot broth and stir back in (do not boil).
Slowly pour in beaten eggs while stirring to form ribbons.
Top with green onion and torn nori.

name: Zucchini Bread Protein Oatmeal
steps: Simmer oats, grated zucchini and almond milk 5 minutes.
Whisk in egg whites while stirring quickly to thicken and add protein; cook 1 minute.
Stir in spices, vanilla and sweetener; top with walnuts.

name: Loaded Veggie Egg White Wrap
steps: Sauté mushrooms and spinach in olive oil 3 minutes.
Add egg whites and scramble until set; stir in roasted pepper and feta.
Spoon into the warmed tortilla and roll up.

name: Cherry Vanilla Protein Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend frozen cherries, yogurt, protein powder, almond milk and vanilla until thick.
Spoon into a bowl.
Top with chia seeds, sliced almonds and coconut.

name: Corned-Beef-Style Brisket Hash with Cabbage
steps: Sauté onion, pepper and shredded cabbage in olive oil until softened and browned in spots, 8 minutes.
Add shredded cooked beef and Dijon; press down and crisp 4 minutes.
Fry eggs and serve on top of the hash.

name: Golden Turmeric Scramble with Chickpeas
steps: Sauté onion in olive oil with turmeric and cumin for 3 minutes.
Add chickpeas and spinach; cook until spinach wilts.
Pour in whisked eggs and scramble softly. Season and garnish with cilantro.

name: Egg White & Turkey Bacon Power Bowl
steps: Cook turkey bacon until crisp and chop.
Wilt spinach in olive oil, add egg whites and scramble.
Assemble in a bowl with tomatoes and avocado; sprinkle with everything seasoning.

name: Apple Pie Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk chia, almond milk, sweetener, vanilla and half the cinnamon; refrigerate overnight.
Sauté diced apple with the remaining cinnamon and nutmeg for 4 minutes until soft.
Top the pudding with warm apple and walnuts.

name: Herbed Goat Cheese Scramble on Rye
steps: Whisk eggs with pepper and cook in butter over low heat, stirring for soft curds.
Fold in goat cheese and herbs off the heat.
Serve over toasted rye.

name: Sausage & Egg Cauliflower Breakfast Burrito Bowl
steps: Sauté cauliflower rice with cumin in half the oil 5 minutes; season and divide into bowls.
Brown sliced sausage, add beans and warm through.
Scramble the eggs in the remaining oil.
Top the cauliflower with sausage, beans, eggs, cheddar, salsa, avocado and cilantro.

name: Peach Cottage Cheese Smoothie
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Add ice for a thicker texture.
Pour and serve.

name: Eggplant & Egg Sabich-Style Plate
steps: Slice eggplant into rounds, brush with olive oil and salt, and roast at 425°F for 18 minutes.
Hard-boil the eggs and slice.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and a little water.
Plate eggplant, eggs, hummus, chopped tomato-cucumber salad and drizzle with tahini sauce.

name: Bulgur Breakfast Bowl with Yogurt & Berries
steps: Warm cooked bulgur with cinnamon.
Divide into bowls and top with Greek yogurt.
Add berries, pistachios and a small drizzle of honey.

name: Shrimp & Grits-Style Cauliflower Bowl
steps: Simmer cauliflower rice with milk 8 minutes, mash lightly and stir in cheddar for creamy 'grits'.
Cook turkey bacon until crisp; chop.
Sauté shrimp with garlic and Cajun seasoning in olive oil 3 minutes; add lemon juice.
Serve shrimp over the cauliflower grits with bacon and green onion.

name: Nut Butter & Berry Yogurt Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with Greek yogurt and dot with almond butter.
Top with raspberries and chia seeds.

name: Southwestern Sweet Potato Egg Boats
steps: Boil whole sweet potatoes 20–25 minutes until tender (boiling keeps the GI far lower than baking); cool slightly.
Split, scoop out some flesh to make a well; fill with beans and cumin.
Crack an egg into each, top with cheddar and bake 12 minutes until set.
Serve with salsa, avocado and cilantro.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Egg White Bites
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and oil a muffin tin.
Blend egg whites with cottage cheese, salt and onion powder.
Divide chopped steamed broccoli and cheddar among cups, pour in the mixture.
Bake 18–20 minutes.

name: Turkish Menemen
steps: Soften onion and pepper in olive oil 6 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook down 6 minutes into a thick sauce; season.
Pour in beaten eggs and stir slowly until soft-set.
Top with feta, parsley and pepper flakes.

name: Oat Bran Porridge with Walnuts & Cinnamon
steps: Simmer oat bran and almond milk, stirring, 3–4 minutes until thick.
Stir in cinnamon and flaxseed.
Top with walnuts and blueberries.

name: Greek Egg & Spinach Pita Pocket
steps: Wilt spinach in olive oil, add whisked eggs with oregano and scramble.
Warm the pita and split open.
Stuff with eggs, feta, tomato and chopped olives.

name: Blueberry Lemon Protein Muffins
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and line 12 muffin cups.
Whisk eggs, yogurt, melted coconut oil, lemon zest and juice; stir in almond flour, protein, baking powder and sweetener.
Fold in blueberries and divide among cups.
Bake 20–22 minutes; cool before storing.

name: Wild Mushroom & Thyme Scramble
steps: Sear mushrooms in olive oil over high heat until browned, 5 minutes; add garlic and thyme.
Lower heat, add whisked eggs and scramble gently.
Finish with parmesan and salt.

name: Cinnamon Roll Overnight Oats
steps: Stir oats, almond milk, half the yogurt, cinnamon, vanilla and sweetener; refrigerate overnight.
Whip cream cheese with the remaining yogurt for a 'frosting'.
Swirl the frosting over the oats and top with pecans.

name: Egg Foo Young Breakfast Patties
steps: Mix eggs with sprouts, green onion, chopped mushrooms, chopped shrimp, tamari and sesame oil.
Ladle 1/2-cup portions into a hot oiled skillet and cook 3 minutes per side.
Serve with extra tamari.

name: Hemp Seed Protein Porridge
steps: Combine hemp, flax, chia and almond milk in a small pot.
Simmer 3–4 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Add cinnamon and stevia; top with blackberries.

name: Ham & Cheese Egg Roll-Ups
steps: Cook eggs as two thin omelets in olive oil.
Spread each with Dijon, layer ham, cheese and spinach.
Roll up tightly, slice into pinwheels.

name: Walnut Yogurt with Cinnamon Apples
steps: Sauté diced apple in butter with cinnamon 4 minutes until tender.
Stir vanilla into the yogurt.
Top with warm apples and walnuts.

name: Southwest Tofu Breakfast Tacos
steps: Crumble tofu and cook in olive oil with taco seasoning 6 minutes until golden.
Warm beans and tortillas.
Fill tortillas with tofu, beans, avocado, salsa, cilantro and lime.

name: Egg White Oatmeal Bowl with Almond Butter
steps: Cook oats in almond milk 4 minutes.
Whisk in egg whites vigorously and cook 2 more minutes until fluffy.
Top with almond butter, cinnamon and raspberries.

name: Asparagus, Prosciutto & Parmesan Baked Eggs
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Toss asparagus with olive oil in a baking dish and roast 8 minutes.
Nestle in torn prosciutto, crack eggs over the top and sprinkle with parmesan.
Bake 7–8 minutes until whites set; finish with pepper and lemon zest.
